Record Class SuperArgumentDef

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.python.processing.model.SuperArgumentDef
Record Components:
source - The argument source text, for diagnostics
keyword - The keyword when the argument was passed by keyword, otherwise null
parameterName - The name of the constructor parameter the argument refers to, otherwise null
type - The static Python type of the argument when it is known (str, int, float, bool, None or the called class), otherwise null
conflictingCall - The source of another super().__init__(...) call of the same constructor that passes different arguments, otherwise null
public record SuperArgumentDef(String source, @Nullable String keyword, @Nullable String parameterName, @Nullable TypeRef type, @Nullable String conflictingCall) extends Record
One argument of the super().__init__(...) call in a Python constructor.

The processor records what it can tell about the argument without running the code: a reference to a constructor parameter, a literal (or f-string) with its Python type, a call of a class, or nothing at all. The stub generator uses the recorded type to pick the Java super constructor that the argument reaches when the Python class extends a Java class.

Since:
5.2.0
Author:
Micronaut Team

    • conflicting

      public static SuperArgumentDef conflicting(String source, String conflictingCall)
      The record of a constructor calling super().__init__(...) in more than one way: the arguments of the first call, with the source of a differing call. A Python class extending a Java class has one Java super constructor, so the calls have to agree.
      Parameters:
      source - The source of the first call
      conflictingCall - The source of a call that differs
      Returns:
      The argument
